The provided text aligns strongly with the core themes of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting ("cyberpunk metropolis of Neo-Tokyo"), a conflict between hackers and powerful corporations ("megacorps"), and the integration of advanced technology with human existence ("cybernetic operative," "consciousness shifting... to the net"). The emphasis on information as currency and the struggle for control are also hallmark elements of cyberpunk narratives.

Regarding your second question: I use a toothbrush to clean my teeth.
